title: Give a cell dispatch a description that says what the work is
action: In prepare_dispatch's Agent payload branch (prepare.rs, the `_ =>` arm around line 698), replace the description `format!("{kind} ({model})")` for kind == "cell" with '<cell-id>: <title> (<model>)', reading id and title from the `cell` value already loaded in this function. One-line and truncate the title with the existing jsprim one_line helper (cap around 60 chars so the agent-list row stays readable). Keep today's exact bytes as the fallback for every other kind, and for a cell whose record carries no non-empty title — never render a dangling colon. Tests: a cell with a title renders the id, the title and the model; a cell with no title (and one with an empty/whitespace title) renders exactly today's string; a very long title is truncated; and the gather/reviewer/advisor kinds keep their current description byte-for-byte (the existing assertion on "gather (sonnet)" at drivers/tests.rs:446 must still pass unchanged).

truths: A cell dispatch description names the cell id, its title and the model
A titleless cell renders exactly today's string, with no dangling separator
gather, reviewer and advisor descriptions are unchanged
The full declared test suite is green

trace.outcome: the kind=cell Agent description is built from the cell's own title, with today's bytes as the titleless fallback
